subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix add an opt-in other-configured-account mention suppression gate, and should its public config match the existing Slack `ignoreOtherMentions` shape?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds Matrix channel configuration and routing semantics that affect multi-account dispatch, room-history preservation, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add a Matrix opt-in gate
options.body: Add a Matrix-owned `ignoreOtherMentions`-style option that defaults off, skips dispatch when another configured Matrix account is visibly mentioned, and records skipped messages as pending context.

options.title: Fold into broader routing policy
options.body: Defer this Matrix-specific change until a shared multi-bot routing policy covers Matrix, Discord, Slack, reply targets, and default owners consistently.

options.title: Keep current controls only
options.body: Leave users on `requireMention`, `allowBots`, and prompt workarounds, and document that Matrix has no non-mentioned-account suppression mode.

recommendation.title: Add a Matrix opt-in gate
recommendation.body: Add a Matrix-owned `ignoreOtherMentions`-style option that defaults off, skips dispatch when another configured Matrix account is visibly mentioned, and records skipped messages as pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent Matrix mention implementation history and related Matrix routing context among the likely owners found.
